post:
  operationId: createProject
  summary: Create a project in the workspace
  x-verification-status: LIVE-VERIFIED
  x-evidence:
    - PROBE-LOG/20260521-020000-post.workspaces.projects-happy-path.json
  x-notes: |
    Returns a single project object (not array). Creator auto-added as ACTIVE PROJECT
    member. Default billable=true (inherits workspace). Default hourlyRate={amount:0,
    currency:USD}. estimate={estimate:PT0S,type:AUTO}. timeEstimate={active:false,
    estimate:PT0S,includeNonBillable:true,resetOption:null,type:AUTO}.
    No clientId/clientName fields when no client assigned (field absent, not null).
    Test object MCP-LIVE-RECON-20260521-020000-D-proj-probe created then archived+deleted.
  x-truth-iter: iter18
  parameters:
    - name: workspaceId
      in: path
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
  requestBody:
    required: true
    content:
      application/json:
        schema:
          type: object
          required:
            - name
          properties:
            name:
              type: string
              maxLength: 150
            color:
              type: string
              description: Hex color code
            isPublic:
              type: boolean
            billable:
              type: boolean
            clientId:
              type: string
  responses:
    '200':
      description: Created project object
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            type: object
            properties:
              id:
                type: string
              name:
                type: string
              color:
                type: string
              archived:
                type: boolean
              billable:
                type: boolean
              duration:
                type: string
              estimate:
                type: object
                properties:
                  estimate:
                    type: string
                  type:
                    type: string
              hourlyRate:
                type: object
                properties:
                  amount:
                    type: integer
                  currency:
                    type: string
              memberships:
                type: array
                items:
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    userId:
                      type: string
                    targetId:
                      type: string
                    membershipType:
                      type: string
                    membershipStatus:
                      type: string
              timeEstimate:
                type: object
              workspaceId:
                type: string
endpoints.notes: Full happy-path probe. Project created, membership update confirmed, then archived and deleted. Response shape fully captured.

        type: string
  requestBody:
    required: true
    content:
      application/json:
        schema:
          type: object
          required:
            - name
            - projectTemplateId
          properties:
            name:

endpoints.truth_yaml:
post:
  operationId: assignProjectMemberships
  summary: Assign or remove users and user groups on a project (delta operation)
  x-verification-status: UNCONFIRMED-AGREE
  x-evidence:
    - PROBE-LOG/20260521-020000-post.workspaces.projects.memberships-path-existence.json
  x-notes: |
    Route confirmed registered: GET /memberships returns 405 (Spring-MVC path-exists rule).
    PATCH is LIVE-VERIFIED from iter16 returning bare array of membership objects.
    POST is distinct from PATCH: POST is a delta (assign or remove users/groups),
    PATCH is replace-all. Go tool clockify_assign_project_memberships uses POST with
    body {remove:bool, userIds:string[], userGroups:{ids,contains,status}}.
    Tool NOT in live MCP registry; raw writes disabled (CLOCKIFY_ENABLE_RAW_WRITES unset).
    Re-probe needed with raw writes enabled to confirm POST response shape.
    PATCH dry_run confirmed body shape: {memberships:[{userId:string}]}.
    PATCH live result: bare array [{costRate,hourlyRate,membershipStatus,
    membershipType,targetId,userId}] (iter16 + re-confirmed this iter).
  x-truth-iter: iter18
  parameters:
    - name: workspaceId
      in: path
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
    - name: projectId
      in: path
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
  requestBody:
    required: true
    content:
      application/json:
        schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            remove:
              type: boolean
              description: When true, removes the specified users/groups instead of adding
            userIds:
              type: array
              items:
                type: string
            userGroups:
              type: object
              properties:
                ids:
                  type: array
                  items:
                    type: string
                contains:
                  type: string
                  enum: [CONTAINS, DOES_NOT_CONTAIN]
                status:
                  type: string
                  enum: [ALL, ACTIVE, INACTIVE]
  responses:
    '200':
      description: Response shape unconfirmed for POST; PATCH returns bare array of membership objects
endpoints.notes: UNCONFIRMED-AGREE. Route existence confirmed via 405 on GET. PATCH live-verified iter16 (bare array response). POST distinct semantics per both specs; Go source implements it but tool not in MCP registry.

endpoints.truth_yaml:
post:
  operationId: getAttendanceReport
  summary: Run the attendance report for a date range
  x-verification-status: LIVE-VERIFIED
  x-evidence:
    - PROBE-LOG/20260521-020000-post.workspaces.reports.attendance-happy-path.json
  x-notes: |
    Read-only POST (query by POST body). Returns object with 'entities' array.
    Entity fields: break, capacity, date, hasRunningEntry, imageUrl, overtime,
    remainingCapacity, timeOff, totalDuration, userId, userName, zonedEnd, zonedStart.
    All time values in seconds (capacity=36000=10h). zonedStart/zonedEnd are local-time
    strings without timezone offset (e.g. '2026-05-21T08:00:00') when entries exist,
    null otherwise. No monetary fields in response. No pagination envelope — flat
    entities array. 5 workspace users returned for single-day range.
    No cleanup needed (read-only).
  x-truth-iter: iter18
  parameters:
    - name: workspaceId
      in: path
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
  requestBody:
    required: true
    content:
      application/json:
        schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            dateRangeStart:
              type: string
              description: RFC3339 datetime or YYYY-MM-DD
            dateRangeEnd:
              type: string
              description: RFC3339 datetime or YYYY-MM-DD
            exportType:
              type: string
              enum: [JSON, JSON_V1, PDF, CSV, XLSX, ZIP]
            attendanceFilter:
              type: object
            detailedFilter:
              type: object
  responses:
    '200':
      description: Attendance report result
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            type: object
            properties:
              entities:
                type: array
                items:
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    break:
                      type: integer
                      description: Break duration in seconds
                    capacity:
                      type: integer
                      description: Daily work capacity in seconds
                    date:
                      type: string
                      description: ISO-8601 date string
                    hasRunningEntry:
                      type: boolean
                    imageUrl:
                      type: string
                    overtime:
                      type: integer
                      description: Overtime in seconds
                    remainingCapacity:
                      type: integer
                      description: capacity minus totalDuration, in seconds
                    timeOff:
                      type: integer
                      description: Time-off duration in seconds
                    totalDuration:
                      type: integer
                      description: Total tracked duration in seconds
                    userId:
                      type: string
                    userName:
                      type: string
                    zonedEnd:
                      type: string
                      nullable: true
                      description: Local-time string without offset, or null
                    zonedStart:
                      type: string
                      nullable: true
                      description: Local-time string without offset, or null
endpoints.notes: Clean happy-path probe. 5 users returned for 2026-05-21 single-day range. One user had 8h tracked (totalDuration=28800, zonedStart/End populated). Response is read-only — no cleanup needed.
